attchmntText: SRIT India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: SRIT India Limited has announced an Earnings Conference Call for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST. Management representatives Dr. Nambiar Raghavan Madhusoodan, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, and Dr. Amit Oberoi, Non-Executive Director, will discuss the operational and financial performance. The discussion will cover key business developments, post-listing progress, and the outlook for the rest of FY27. Investors will have the opportunity to ask questions after the presentation. The company confirmed that no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information will be shared or discussed during the call. Further information can be obtained via researchteam@cokaco.com or phone numbers 022-40790051 and 022-40790053.

attchmntText: SRIT India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: SRIT India Limited published newspaper advertisements regarding its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The disclosures were published in the Financial Express English edition and the Samyukta Karnataka Kannada edition. The company also made the information available on its website at www.sritindia.com. This filing was submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The notice was signed by Nidhi Hitesh Vaswani, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: SRIT India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: SRIT India Limited received an order from Ooredoo QPSC valued at Qatari Riyals ~50million, equivalent to ₹1,289.3 Million. The contract is for managed services regarding Electronic Health and Information Systems for Pharmacy and Drug Control Departments. The entity awarding the order is an international client. The agreement involves a two-year period for onboarding hospitals, clinics, health centers, and pharmacies, and a three-year period for managed services of the E-Health Eco System and National Drug Control roll-out operations. The contract is executed between SRIT’s branch in Doha QFC, Qatar, and Ooredoo QPSC. There is no interest held by the promoter group in the awarding entity, and the transaction does not constitute a related party transaction.

attchmntText: SRIT India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Management Commentary of the Company on the Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.'
voiceSummary: SRIT India Limited filed a management commentary on financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was 1,047.0 million in Q2 FY27, up 29.0 percent year-on-year. Profit after tax for Q2 FY27 stood at 137.4 million. For H1 FY27, revenue was 1,925.1 million and profit after tax was 205.5 million. Net cash flow from operating activities for H1 FY27 was 865.3 million. Cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026, were 1,084.9 million. The company completed its initial public offering of 16.80 million equity shares at 130 per share, aggregating 2,184.0 million. Shares were listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on October 6, 2026.
